svg.aria-label: A block of 32 by 8 threads drawn as 8 rows of a grid. For warp 3, its 3 row segments are highlighted: the row of warp 2 above, its own row with 1 extra cell at each end, and the row of warp 4 below. The block as a whole touches 10 rows of the old grid, its 8 rows and 1 on each side, so each old value is fetched from memory about 1.25 times per cell written.
svg.text: The rows read by a block
Neighbouring warps read each other's rows: 8 rows of results need 10 old rows.
The block of 32 × 8 threads computes rows 1 to 8 (warps 0 to 7). Warp 3 reads the rows of warps 2
and 4 as well as its own. The block as a whole touches 10 rows of the old grid: 10 / 8 = 1.25
old values per cell computed, if each row segment comes from memory once.
